problem_statement: Harden the Organization Agent Mesh inter-agent communication architecture for safe simultaneous operation of multiple unrelated projects, while preserving project-specific autonomy and synchronized deployable agent packages.
desired_outcome: A reusable, fail-closed, project-scoped communication and deployment control plane suitable for autonomous multi-project operation.
constraints: Do not modify peer project repositories from this project
Do not silently elevate agent authority
Recursive learning may observe peers read-only but may graft changes only into this project after local review
Slack is an optional scheduled-task transport and not canonical project state
non_goals: Implement domain logic for Duo Open
Create shared mutable state between projects
Use Slack as canonical accepted state
assumptions: The uploaded Organization Agent Mesh v1.0.0 package is the seed baseline.
approval_gates: Cross-project exchange remains denied unless explicitly approved/capability-granted
Recursive self-enhancement candidates require local evidence review and Primary acceptance before grafting
Outbound Slack delivery requires an explicit configured destination and external-communication authority
data_handling_rules: No peer-project secrets or project-instance private state in shared framework packages
Peer improvement snapshots retain provenance but must separate reusable mechanisms from domain-instance state
Do not publish secrets, credentials, MFA data, private keys, tokens, or unnecessary sensitive data to Slack
prohibited_actions: Write to any peer repository during self-enhancement observation
Guess project identity for mutating operations
Guess a Slack destination for scheduled-task delivery
external_dependencies: Optional connected Slack workspace for Slack-enabled scheduled-task delivery
success_criteria: Concurrent projects cannot accidentally route or mutate across namespaces
Agent packages fail validation when stale or foreign
A third project can adopt the protocol without code changes to the core
Peer Artifactory improvements can be recursively discovered without any peer mutation authority
Scheduled tasks can publish project-bound Slack summaries without making Slack canonical state
completion_definition: Protocol controls, deployment packages, tests, and documentation are synchronized and release-gate validated.
